title: Hopper FP8 stability adapter and calibration runbook for E4M3 vs E5M2
creator: Sofia Martinez
description: Deliver a stable FP8 enablement path for Hopper (H100+) with an adapter that selects between E4M3 and E5M2 profiles automatically, plus a reproducible calibration runbook. This ticket covers: 1) calibration harness and dataset sweep, 2) per-layer profile collection and heuristics for E4M3/E5M2 selection, 3) runtime stability mitigations (overflow clamping, EMA scale smoothing, fallback thresholds), 4) CI and regression tests + perf/accuracy dashboards, and 5) rollout plan with canary and auto-fallback to INT8/FP16.
background: We have several experimental FP8 calibrations showing promising throughput and cost wins on Hopper, but intermittent stability issues (NaNs/inf, quality regressions on rare prompts) remain. Prior tickets implemented calibration pipelines and initial FP8 profiles (see ENG-20688 and related), but we need a productized adapter + operational runbook that keeps customer applications safe while enabling aggressive quantization.
acceptance_criteria: Adapter can choose E4M3 or E5M2 per-model/per-batch with deterministic heuristics and low runtime overhead
Calibration runbook produces stable profiles for 95% of models in our onboarding set without manual tuning
CI regression suite catches introduced instabilities (NaN rate < 0.01% per 1M tokens) and accuracy drift <= 0.5% measured by validation prompts
Canary rollout (5% traffic) with auto-fallback triggers when quality or error budgets are exceeded
Monitoring dashboards show per-layer scale histograms, overflow counts, and selected profile distribution
tasks: Implement runtime adapter: profile ingestion, heuristic selector, and small overhead hot path
Extend calibration harness for per-layer activation histograms and overflow probability estimate
Define heuristics: L2-norm stability, activation kurtosis, per-channel max ratio — map to E4M3/E5M2 decision boundary
Implement stability mitigations: clamp ops, per-channel EMA smoothing for scales, emergency INT8 fallback
Add unit/integration tests to CI and a nightly calibration sweep job
Create Confluence runbook and operator playbook for manual remediation
Create dashboards and SLO alerts; instrument telemetry in the runtime
progress_updates: 2026-02-12: Spike completed — calibration harness extended to capture per-layer activation histograms and peak-to-mean ratio. Found two transformer layers with heavy tail activations that drove earlier NaNs.
2026-02-20: Implemented prototype EMA smoothing for FP8 scale updates. Reduced intermittent NaNs in unit tests from 0.7% to 0.04% across the validation set.

2026-02-28: Heuristic design doc drafted: use overflow_probability and activation_kurtosis to pick E5M2 when overflow_probability > 1e-5 or kurtosis > 12; otherwise default to E4M3. Added conservative hysteresis to avoid flapping.
2026-03-05: Runtime adapter initial implementation merged to feature branch. Hot-path overhead measured ~0.3% latency increase in microbenchmarks.
2026-03-10: Nightly calibration sweep started against 30 open-source checkpoints. 27/30 produced stable profiles with default heuristics; 3 require manual per-layer thresholds — added as follow-ups.

2026-03-12: Canary plan approved by SRE and Product. Added alerting for NaN spike >0.05% and perplexity regression >0.8% on validation prompt set. Will start 1% traffic canary after integration testing.
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Rare activation distributions can still cause overflow during long context generation. Mitigation: emergency clamp and fallback-to-INT8 path that preserves recent KV cache to avoid cold restarts.

Risk: Heuristic false positives may choose conservative profile and lose cost savings. Mitigation: collect telemetry and run offline calibration sweep to refine decision boundary; A/B test selector thresholds.
Risk: Operator burden during incidents. Mitigation: provide clear Confluence runbook and automation to roll back to pinned FP16/INT8 images automatically.
ci: Added nightly job: fp8-calibration-sweep (runs on dedicated calibration pool), unit tests in runtime/flaky_detector, and integration tests in inference-e2e with random seeds fixed
deployment_plan: Stage 1: Merge feature branch behind runtime flag. Stage 2: Nightly sweep and CI for 2 weeks. Stage 3: Canary to 1% traffic for internal customers (2 days), monitor overflow/NaN and validation prompts. Stage 4: Increase to 5% with auto-fallback enabled. Stage 5: Full rollout if metrics stable for 7 days.
notes: Operator playbook must include commands to toggle runtime flag and to force select E4M3/E5M2 per-model for debugging.
Keep a training-quality validation set (1K prompts) to detect subtle generations regressions; include cost/throughput reporting to quantify tradeoffs.
Consider follow-up ticket to expose profile confidence score in model metadata for consumption by Console rollouts UI.
